2126107045397238079.en_summary: Trump says Jensen Huang is not a security threat based on "the information I have, which is a lot of information". Trump: he's a good man, gonna do a great job, better the second time. When asked how sure given DOJ no proper investigation, based on information and belief he's absolutely fine. Mentions $NVDA.
